mapper.select: select r.*, ( select count(*) from message msg where msg.message_room = r.room_no and msg.message_time > NVL(r.last_employee_read_time, to_date('1970-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ) AS unread_cnt from room r where r.room_no = #{roomNo}

select r.*, ( select count(*) from message msg inner join message_chat mc on mc.message_no = msg.message_no where msg.message_room = r.room_no and mc.message_sender_no != #{roomOwner} and msg.message_time > NVL(ru.last_read_time, to_date('1970-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ) AS unread_cnt from room r inner join room_user ru on ru.room_no = r.room_no where r.room_owner = #{roomOwner} and r.room_type = '상담'

select R.*, A.account_type, A.account_name, M.last_time, M.last_content, NVL(U.cnt, 0) cnt, ( select count(*) from message msg inner join message_chat mc on mc.message_no = msg.message_no where msg.message_room = r.room_no and mc.message_sender_no = r.room_owner and (r.last_employee_read_time is null or msg.message_time > r.last_employee_read_time) ) as unread_cnt, 'N' enter from room R left join ( select room_no, count(*) cnt from room_user group by room_no ) U on R.room_no = U.room_no inner join ( select message_room, max(message_time) as last_time, max(message_content) keep (dense_rank last order by message_time) as last_content from message group by message_room ) M on R.room_no = M.message_room inner join account A on A.account_no = R.room_owner where R.room_type = '상담' order by M.last_time desc

select R.*, nvl(U.cnt, 0) cnt, nvl2(MY.account_id, 'Y', 'N') enter from room R left outer join ( select room_no, count(*) cnt from room_user group by room_no ) U on R.room_no = U.room_no left outer join ( select * from room_user where account_no = #{accountNo} ) MY on R.room_no = MY.room_no order by R.room_no asc
select ACC.account_no, ACC.account_name, ACC.account_type from room_user RU inner join account ACC on RU.account_no = ACC.account_no where room_no = #{roomNo}
